overrides.reason: The constituency page duplicates 2021 party vote rows above an internally inconsistent legacy turnout block (57,452 registered while recognized 2021 party votes sum to 144,731). The Béni-Mellal province/circumscription electorate was reported as 318,608 registered voters for the 8 September 2021 elections, based on Wilaya data.
overrides.effect: With 318,608 registered, q=53,101.33 for six seats; no list reaches one full quotient and the six largest remainders are exactly RNI, PAM, PI, USFP, MP, PPS, matching the reported six elected lists.
